# iosxe_wireless_ap_join_profile (Resource)

This resource can manage the Wireless AP Join Profile configuration. The device's built-in `default-ap-profile` cannot be deleted: destroying it only removes the attributes Terraform configured, which reverts them like the matching `no` commands (a description is cleared).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_ap_join_profile" "example" {
  name                                                  = "S3-AP-JOIN-1"
  description                                           = "S3 AP Join Profile Test"
  capwap_window_size                                    = 5
  country                                               = "us"
  ssh                                                   = true
  mgmtuser_username                                     = "apadmin"
  mgmtuser_password                                     = "Wl4nMgmtPw7x!"
  mgmtuser_password_type                                = "clear"
  mgmtuser_secret                                       = "Wl4nMgmtSc9q!"
  mgmtuser_secret_type                                  = "clear"
  ntp_ip                                                = "10.10.10.5"
  syslog_host                                           = "10.10.10.6"
  syslog_facility                                       = "facility-local6"
  syslog_level                                          = "syslog-level-warning"
  apphost                                               = true
  association_limit                                     = 200
  awips                                                 = true
  awips_forensic                                        = true
  capwap_retransmit_count                               = 6
  capwap_retransmit_interval                            = 4
  capwap_timers_discovery_timeout                       = 5
  capwap_timers_fast_heartbeat_timeout                  = 1
  capwap_timers_heartbeat_timeout                       = 10
  capwap_timers_primary_discovery_timeout               = 60
  capwap_timers_primed_join_timeout                     = 120
  capwap_backup_primary_name                            = "wlc-dc1"
  capwap_backup_primary_ip                              = "10.10.10.11"
  capwap_backup_secondary_name                          = "wlc-dc2"
  capwap_backup_secondary_ip                            = "10.20.20.11"
  capwap_fallback                                       = false
  capwap_discovery_private                              = false
  capwap_discovery_public                               = false
  cdp                                                   = false
  dot1x_eap_type                                        = "dot1x-eap-tls"
  dot1x_username                                        = "apuser"
  dot1x_password                                        = "Dt1xPw8kzQ!"
  dot1x_password_type                                   = "clear"
  hyperlocation                                         = true
  ip_dhcp_fallback                                      = false
  lag                                                   = true
  led                                                   = false
  rogue_detection_enable                                = false
  rogue_detection_min_rssi                              = -80
  rogue_detection_min_transient_time                    = 120
  rogue_detection_report_interval                       = 30
  statistics_ap_system_monitoring_enable                = true
  statistics_ap_system_monitoring_alarm_enable          = true
  statistics_ap_system_monitoring_alarm_hold_time       = 10
  statistics_ap_system_monitoring_alarm_retransmit_time = 5
  statistics_ap_system_monitoring_cpu_threshold         = 90
  statistics_ap_system_monitoring_mem_threshold         = 90
  statistics_ap_system_monitoring_sampling_interval     = 60
  statistics_ap_system_monitoring_stats_interval        = 600
  statistics_traffic_distribution                       = false
  statistics_traffic_distribution_interval              = 600
  statistics_ap_radio_monitoring_enable                 = true
  statistics_ap_radio_monitoring_sampling_interval      = 900
  stats_timer                                           = 120
  tcp_adjust_mss_enable                                 = false
  tcp_adjust_mss_size                                   = 1200
  ble_scan                                              = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The ap configuration profile name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apphost` (Boolean) Enable IOX application hosting
- `association_limit` (Number) Maximum clients per AP configuration
  - Range: `0`-`1200`
- `awips` (Boolean) Flag to enable AWIPS
- `awips_forensic` (Boolean) Flag to enable AWIPS forensic
- `ble_scan` (Boolean) Set the BLE scan state
- `capwap_backup_primary_ip` (String) the AP's primary controller ip address
- `capwap_backup_primary_name` (String) the AP's primary controller name
- `capwap_backup_secondary_ip` (String) the AP's secondary controller ip address
- `capwap_backup_secondary_name` (String) the AP's secondary controller name
- `capwap_discovery_private` (Boolean) Discovery Response from private IP is enabled or disabled
- `capwap_discovery_public` (Boolean) Discovery Response from public IP is enabled or disabled
- `capwap_fallback` (Boolean) Backup Controllers fallback enabled
- `capwap_retransmit_count` (Number) retransmit timer count
  - Range: `3`-`8`
- `capwap_retransmit_interval` (Number) retransmit timer interval
  - Range: `2`-`5`
- `capwap_timers_discovery_timeout` (Number) This object represents the timeout for the AP discovery
  - Range: `1`-`10`
- `capwap_timers_fast_heartbeat_timeout` (Number) This object represents the timeout value for the heart beat timer.
  - Range: `0`-`10`
- `capwap_timers_heartbeat_timeout` (Number) This object represents the Heartbeattimeout for the AP discovery
  - Range: `1`-`30`
- `capwap_timers_primary_discovery_timeout` (Number) This object represents the timeout for the primary AP discovery
  - Range: `30`-`3000`
- `capwap_timers_primed_join_timeout` (Number) This object represents the primed timeout for the AP discovery
  - Range: `0`-`43200`
- `capwap_window_size` (Number) CAPWAP window size for request packets in multiwindow queue
  - Range: `1`-`50`
- `cdp` (Boolean) True if CDP enabled for the AP
- `country` (String) AP country code
  - Choices: `ad`, `ae`, `af`, `ag`, `ai`, `al`, `am`, `ao`, `aq`, `ar`, `as`, `at`, `au`, `aw`, `ax`, `az`, `ba`, `bb`, `bd`, `be`, `bf`, `bg`, `bh`, `bi`, `bj`, `bl`, `bm`, `bn`, `bo`, `bq`, `br`, `bs`, `bt`, `bv`, `bw`, `by`, `bz`, `ca`, `cc`, `cd`, `cf`, `cg`, `ch`, `ci`, `ck`, `cl`, `cm`, `cn`, `co`, `cr`, `cu`, `cv`, `cw`, `cx`, `cy`, `cz`, `de`, `dj`, `dk`, `dm`, `do`, `dz`, `ec`, `ee`, `eg`, `eh`, `el`, `er`, `es`, `et`, `fi`, `fj`, `fk`, `fm`, `fo`, `fr`, `ga`, `gb`, `gd`, `ge`, `gf`, `gg`, `gh`, `gi`, `gl`, `gm`, `gn`, `gp`, `gq`, `gr`, `gs`, `gt`, `gu`, `gw`, `gy`, `hk`, `hm`, `hn`, `hr`, `ht`, `hu`, `id`, `ie`, `il`, `im`, `in`, `io`, `iq`, `ir`, `is`, `it`, `j2`, `j3`, `j4`, `je`, `jm`, `jo`, `jp`, `ke`, `kg`, `kh`, `ki`, `km`, `kn`, `kp`, `kr`, `kw`, `ky`, `kz`, `la`, `lb`, `lc`, `li`, `lk`, `lr`, `ls`, `lt`, `lu`, `lv`, `ly`, `ma`, `mc`, `md`, `me`, `mf`, `mg`, `mh`, `mk`, `ml`, `mm`, `mn`, `mo`, `mp`, `mq`, `mr`, `ms`, `mt`, `mu`, `mv`, `mw`, `mx`, `my`, `mz`, `na`, `nc`, `ne`, `nf`, `ng`, `ni`, `nl`, `no`, `np`, `nr`, `nu`, `nz`, `om`, `pa`, `pe`, `pf`, `pg`, `ph`, `pk`, `pl`, `pm`, `pn`, `pr`, `ps`, `pt`, `pw`, `py`, `qa`, `re`, `ro`, `rs`, `ru`, `rw`, `sa`, `sb`, `sc`, `sd`, `se`, `sg`, `sh`, `si`, `sj`, `sk`, `sl`, `sm`, `sn`, `so`, `sr`, `ss`, `st`, `sv`, `sx`, `sy`, `sz`, `tc`, `td`, `tf`, `tg`, `th`, `ti`, `tj`, `tk`, `tl`, `tm`, `tn`, `to`, `tr`, `tt`, `tv`, `tw`, `tz`, `ua`, `ug`, `um`, `unconfigured`, `us`, `uy`, `uz`, `va`, `vc`, `ve`, `vg`, `vi`, `vn`, `vu`, `wf`, `ws`, `xk`, `ye`, `yt`, `za`, `zm`, `zw`
- `description` (String) Description for the ap configuration profile
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `dot1x_eap_type` (String) Dot1x EAP auth type
  - Choices: `dot1x-eap-fast`, `dot1x-eap-none`, `dot1x-eap-peap`, `dot1x-eap-tls`
- `dot1x_password` (String, Sensitive) AP dot1x authentication password

- `dot1x_password_wo_version` (Number) The write-only version of the attribute.
- `dot1x_username` (String) AP dot1x authentication username
- `hyperlocation` (Boolean) enable hyperlocation
- `ip_dhcp_fallback` (Boolean) Represents AP fallback to DHCP, if AP fails to join via static IP address
- `lag` (Boolean) boolean to indicate whether ap lag enabled is used
- `led` (Boolean) True if LED state is enabled otherwise disabled.
- `mesh_profile` (String) Specifies the mesh profile name for the AP
- `mgmtuser_password` (String, Sensitive) AP user management password. Following criteria should be met if wireless password policy is configured. - Default passwords (cisco, Cisco, C!sco, ci$co, ..) are not allowed. - Reverse default passwords are not allowed. - At least one lower case letter is mandatory. - At least one upper case letter is mandatory. - At least one digit is mandatory. - Special characters are allowed, but not mandatory. - More than two sequential chars or digits (e.g., abc, 123) are not allowed. - More than two repeated chars or digits (e.g., 111, aaa) are not allowed. - Minimum password length is 8. Restriction: AP management password of cleartext type must contain ASCII characters only. This rule is not implemented using constraints.
- `mgmtuser_password_type` (String) AP user management password type
  - Choices: `aes`, `clear`, `clear-to-aes`, `clear-to-ike-aes`, `clear-to-md5`, `clear-to-sha`, `clear-to-type7`, `ike-aes`, `md5`, `sha`, `type7`
- `mgmtuser_password_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The write-only value of the attribute.
- `mgmtuser_password_wo_version` (Number) The write-only version of the attribute.
- `mgmtuser_secret` (String, Sensitive) AP user management secret
- `mgmtuser_secret_type` (String) AP user management secret type
  - Choices: `aes`, `clear`, `clear-to-aes`, `clear-to-ike-aes`, `clear-to-md5`, `clear-to-sha`, `clear-to-type7`, `ike-aes`, `md5`, `sha`, `type7`
- `mgmtuser_secret_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The write-only value of the attribute.
- `mgmtuser_secret_wo_version` (Number) The write-only version of the attribute.
- `mgmtuser_username` (String) AP user management username
- `ntp_ip` (String) NTP server IP address
- `rogue_detection_enable` (Boolean) rogue AP detection
- `rogue_detection_min_rssi` (Number) minmum RSSI for AP rogue detection
  - Range: `-128`-`70`
- `rogue_detection_min_transient_time` (Number) transient interval for AP rogue detection
- `rogue_detection_report_interval` (Number) time interval at which monitor mode report for AP rogue detection is generated
  - Range: `10`-`300`
- `ssh` (Boolean) This object specifies whether SSH session can be established to the AP
- `statistics_ap_radio_monitoring_enable` (Boolean) AP radio stats collection and processing enabled
- `statistics_ap_radio_monitoring_sampling_interval` (Number) Sampling interval of radio statistics
  - Range: `720`-`3600`
- `statistics_ap_system_monitoring_alarm_enable` (Boolean) AP stats alarms enabled
- `statistics_ap_system_monitoring_alarm_hold_time` (Number) Alarm hold time
  - Range: `0`-`3600`
- `statistics_ap_system_monitoring_alarm_retransmit_time` (Number) Alarm trap retransmission time
  - Range: `0`-`65535`
- `statistics_ap_system_monitoring_cpu_threshold` (Number) CPU threshold
  - Range: `0`-`100`
- `statistics_ap_system_monitoring_enable` (Boolean) AP stats collection and processing enabled
- `statistics_ap_system_monitoring_mem_threshold` (Number) Memory threshold
  - Range: `0`-`100`
- `statistics_ap_system_monitoring_sampling_interval` (Number) Sampling interval
  - Range: `2`-`900`
- `statistics_ap_system_monitoring_stats_interval` (Number) Statistics interval
  - Range: `120`-`900`
- `statistics_traffic_distribution` (Boolean) Enable/Disable client traffic distribution stats
- `statistics_traffic_distribution_interval` (Number) Interval at which AP will send the statistics
  - Range: `30`-`3600`
- `stats_timer` (Number) APs stats timer
  - Range: `0`-`65535`
- `syslog_facility` (String) facility value
  - Choices: `facility-auth`, `facility-cron`, `facility-daemon`, `facility-kern`, `facility-local0`, `facility-local1`, `facility-local2`, `facility-local3`, `facility-local4`, `facility-local5`, `facility-local6`, `facility-local7`, `facility-lpr`, `facility-mail`, `facility-news`, `facility-sys10`, `facility-sys11`, `facility-sys12`, `facility-sys13`, `facility-sys14`, `facility-sys9`, `facility-syslog`, `facility-user`, `facility-uucp`
- `syslog_host` (String) host name
- `syslog_level` (String) log level
  - Choices: `syslog-level-alert`, `syslog-level-critical`, `syslog-level-debug`, `syslog-level-emergency`, `syslog-level-errors`, `syslog-level-information`, `syslog-level-notification`, `syslog-level-warning`
- `tcp_adjust_mss_enable` (Boolean) adjust mss
- `tcp_adjust_mss_size` (Number) This object represents the Global AP TCP MSS value
  - Range: `536`-`1363`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_ap_join_profile.example "<name>"
```
